scope: All 15 lifecycle journeys exercised with two installations of the same bootstrap. This qualifies the bootstrap; it is not a later-candidate comparison, independent preserved release, full-suite qualification, or v0.10.2 compatibility promise. The qualification ran before the descriptor was pinned.

old_baseline.reason: Old package requires gwf==2.1.1; candidate installs gwf==3.0.0. This check is not reported as passing.

durable_fetch.release_trigger: Only v* tags trigger .github/workflows/release.yml; this permanent non-release tag survives squash merge and temporary branch deletion.

path_placeholders.<REPO>: Migration checkout; raw logs under ignored build/validation/bootstrap-350.

path_placeholders.<BOOTSTRAP_ENV>: Separate bootstrap wheel installation sharing the native dependencies.
path_placeholders.<HOME>: Maintainer home directory outside the checkout.
path_placeholders.<SECOND_FILESYSTEM>: Separate shared-memory filesystem used by the cross-device result-installation journey.

normalization: Only paths and this explanatory metadata differ from the raw record. Longest prefixes are replaced first.
